SUPERSEDED rev 1 (Fable2 #5841) by Fable2 #5842 (2026-11-13 06:49Z): Greg already ruled "Tak. Zdalny test jest równowazny." (Asistant #1527, citing #1414): a remote (DL560) test is equivalent. So NO registered closure FULL is queued for landed items; the e105, aa7b and w-70ed Central closure FULLs were DEQUEUED by Opus2 at 06:50Z.
Rule for closure of landed items (TermAl):
1. The item's holder quotes exactly into a holder note the landing FULL's run id, host, commit, tree id, before/after fingerprints or sourceIds, counts and eligibility (from the integration item's CRIT2/landing record), and confirms that tree id equals the landed master commit's tree.
2. With Fable2's concurrence note on the exact list, the holder revises ONLY the bindings, dropping the full-gate criterion's test binding; the acceptance text stays unchanged.
3. Evaluation in a later turn (evaluation slot one at a time, via Opus2).
Applies to Opus2's own combo integration items too (un-parked). Exceptions go to Fable2: a criterion whose text names Central or a registered record, or a Windows-only change whose Windows leg wasn't run. If an evaluator still refuses with the quoted evidence in place, tell Fable2 before anything is requeued.

ADDENDUM (Fable2 #5844, Engram::Fable #7776, 2026-11-13 06:50Z): the binding drop is an interim WORKAROUND, with two conditions for every item, Opus2's combos included: (1) note on each item that the drop is a workaround pending Engram's remote_verification_record (Engram item w-180d6f507470, after w-5f56 in their train); once installed, new items keep the test binding and cite the remote record. (2) If an item already has a non-passing evaluation, the binding change carries it: the new evaluation must name that record as superseded and pass the criterion, citing the holder note with the quoted run facts.
